official_sources.name: MiniMax Open Platform Paid Services Agreement
observed_facts: Token Plan Subscription Key and standard pay-as-you-go API Key are separate and non-interchangeable.
Token Plan model eligibility, quota, concurrency and other entitlements may vary by plan.

official_sources.name: MiniMax Token Plan
observed_facts: Official page exposes Token Plan and Team Subscription options at observation time.
Official FAQ recommends pay-as-you-go for production use.
Plan quotas and rate limits are service entitlements rather than canonical model capabilities.

official_sources.name: MiniMax H3 Open Source
observed_facts: H3 system separates H3-Context-IR, H3-Base and H3-Regenerate-2K.
Full 2K workflow may combine locally deployed H3-Base with hosted H3-Context-IR and H3-Regenerate-2K APIs.
H3 open weights use the MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement.

official_sources.name: MiniMax H3 API pricing
observed_facts: H3 hosted video generation is billed as a service offering.
Current prices are volatile commercial metadata and are not canonical FA3 contract values.
